```{r}
# 1) 构图：将 ground truth + 时间矩阵 合成为加权邻接 wt
build_weight_matrix <- function(graph_matrix, time_matrix) {
  stopifnot(is.matrix(graph_matrix), is.matrix(time_matrix))
  stopifnot(identical(dimnames(graph_matrix), dimnames(time_matrix)))

  # 基于 ground truth：仅当 graph==1 时使用 time；否则视为无边(Inf)
  wt <- matrix(Inf, nrow(graph_matrix), ncol(graph_matrix),
               dimnames = dimnames(graph_matrix))

  true_edges <- which(graph_matrix == 1, arr.ind = TRUE)
  if (nrow(true_edges) > 0) {
    te_time <- time_matrix[true_edges]
    # 允许 time_matrix 在 graph==0 处有值，但此处不会被用到（被忽略）
    if (any(is.na(te_time) | !is.finite(te_time) | te_time <= 0)) {
      stop("For edges with graph_matrix==1, time_matrix must provide positive finite times.")
    }
    te_time <- as.integer(round(te_time))  # 强制为整数
    if (any(te_time <= 0)) {
      stop("Rounded times for true edges must remain positive integers.")
    }
    wt[true_edges] <- te_time
  }
  wt
}

# 2) 预计算所有对最短路
#    - engine="igraph" 推荐（大图更快）；"dijkstra" 为 O(n^2) 简洁实现
precompute_shortest_paths <- function(wt, engine = c("igraph", "dijkstra")) {
  engine <- match.arg(engine)
  n <- nrow(wt)
  stopifnot(ncol(wt) == n)

  if (engine == "igraph") {
    if (!requireNamespace("igraph", quietly = TRUE)) {
      stop("Please install.packages('igraph') or use engine='dijkstra'.")
    }
    g <- igraph::graph_from_adjacency_matrix(
      wt, mode = "directed", weighted = TRUE
    )
    # igraph::distances: 行是源，列是目的
    dist_mat <- igraph::distances(g, mode = "out", weights = igraph::E(g)$weight)
    rownames(dist_mat) <- rownames(wt)
    colnames(dist_mat) <- colnames(wt)
    return(dist_mat)
  } else {
    # 朴素多次 Dijkstra（每个节点当源跑一次）
    dijkstra_single_source <- function(wt_mat, s) {
      dist <- rep(Inf, n)
      visited <- rep(FALSE, n)
      dist[s] <- 0L
      for (.iter in seq_len(n)) {
        u <- which.min(ifelse(visited, Inf, dist))
        if (!is.finite(dist[u])) break
        visited[u] <- TRUE
        nbrs <- which(is.finite(wt_mat[u, ]))
        if (length(nbrs) > 0) {
          alt <- dist[u] + wt_mat[u, nbrs]
          to_update <- alt < dist[nbrs]
          if (any(to_update)) dist[nbrs[to_update]] <- alt[to_update]
        }
      }
      dist
    }
    dist_mat <- sapply(seq_len(n), function(s) dijkstra_single_source(wt, s))
    dist_mat <- t(dist_mat)  # 行=源，列=目的
    rownames(dist_mat) <- rownames(wt)
    colnames(dist_mat) <- colnames(wt)
    return(dist_mat)
  }
}

# 3) 基于预计算 dist_mat 的快速可达判定
#    多源最短路等价于对源集合行做列向量元素最小值（min over sources）
compute_edge_reachability_from_dist <- function(
  intervene_matrix,
  dist_mat,
  detected_time = 1L,
  error_rate = 0
) {
  stopifnot(is.matrix(intervene_matrix), is.matrix(dist_mat))
  stopifnot(identical(colnames(intervene_matrix), rownames(dist_mat)))
  stopifnot(identical(colnames(intervene_matrix), colnames(dist_mat)))

  num_experiments <- nrow(intervene_matrix)
  genes <- colnames(intervene_matrix)
  n <- length(genes)

  result <- matrix(0L, nrow = num_experiments, ncol = n,
                   dimnames = list(rownames(intervene_matrix), genes))

  # 尽量加速：优先使用 matrixStats::colMins；否则 fallback 到 apply
  use_ms <- requireNamespace("matrixStats", quietly = TRUE)

  for (i in seq_len(num_experiments)) {
    sources <- which(intervene_matrix[i, ] == 1L)
    if (length(sources) == 0) next

    # 选取源对应的行子矩阵
    subD <- dist_mat[genes[sources], , drop = FALSE]

    # 多源最短路 = 对 subD 的行做列最小
    if (nrow(subD) == 1L) {
      minDist <- subD[1L, ]
    } else if (use_ms) {
      minDist <- matrixStats::colMins(subD, na.rm = TRUE)
    } else {
      minDist <- apply(subD, 2L, min, na.rm = TRUE)
    }

    reachable <- is.finite(minDist) & (minDist <= detected_time)
    result[i, reachable] <- 1L

    # 按原规则：干预到的基因置 NA
    result[i, genes[sources]] <- NA_integer_
  }

  # 可选：注入翻转噪声（跳过 NA）
  if (error_rate > 0) {
    non_na_mask <- !is.na(result)
    flip_candidates <- which(non_na_mask)
    num_flips <- ceiling(length(flip_candidates) * error_rate)
    if (num_flips > 0) {
      flip_indices <- sample(flip_candidates, num_flips)
      result[flip_indices] <- 1L - result[flip_indices]
    }
  }

  result
}
```


```{r}
build_time_matrix_manual <- function(
  adj_truth,
  props,                # 数值向量，表示各档的比例（将归一化使和为1）
  times,                # 整数向量，表示各档对应的传播时间；长度须与 props 相同
  seed         = NULL,  # 设定则可复现
  non_edge_fill = 0L,   # 非边填充值：0L 或 NA_integer_
  shuffle_edges = TRUE  # 是否对真边顺序洗牌后再分配
) {
  stopifnot(is.matrix(adj_truth))
  if (!all(adj_truth %in% c(0, 1))) {
    stop("adj_truth must be a 0/1 adjacency matrix.")
  }
  stopifnot(is.numeric(props), is.numeric(times), length(props) == length(times))
  if (any(times <= 0) || any(!is.finite(times))) {
    stop("`times` must be positive finite numbers (integers will be enforced).")
  }
  times <- as.integer(round(times))

  if (!is.null(seed)) set.seed(seed)

  # 找到所有真边的 (i,j) 索引
  edges <- which(adj_truth == 1L, arr.ind = TRUE)
  m <- nrow(edges)

  tm <- matrix(non_edge_fill,
               nrow = nrow(adj_truth),
               ncol = ncol(adj_truth),
               dimnames = dimnames(adj_truth))

  if (m == 0L) {
    warning("No edges in adj_truth; return all `non_edge_fill` matrix.")
    return(tm)
  }

  # 归一化 props，并用“最大余数法”得到各档计数，保证总和 == m
  props <- pmax(props, 0)
  if (sum(props) == 0) stop("All `props` are zero; nothing to assign.")
  p <- props / sum(props)

  raw_counts <- m * p
  base_counts <- floor(raw_counts)
  residue <- raw_counts - base_counts
  # 剩余需要分配的数量
  remaining <- m - sum(base_counts)
  if (remaining > 0) {
    # 选择 residue 最大的 remaining 个档位，+1
    idx <- order(residue, decreasing = TRUE)[seq_len(remaining)]
    base_counts[idx] <- base_counts[idx] + 1L
  }
  counts <- base_counts
  stopifnot(sum(counts) == m)

  # 可选：洗牌以打散原有顺序
  ord <- if (shuffle_edges) sample.int(m, m) else seq_len(m)

  # 依次取前 counts[k] 条边赋值 times[k]
  start <- 1L
  for (k in seq_along(times)) {
    c_k <- counts[k]
    if (c_k <= 0L) next
    idx_k <- ord[start:(start + c_k - 1L)]
    ij <- edges[idx_k, , drop = FALSE]
    tm[ij] <- times[k]
    start <- start + c_k
  }

  tm
}
```

```{r}
build_time_matrix_dist <- function(
  adj_truth,
  dist = c("norm"),
  params = list(mean = 1, sd = 0.25),
  non_edge_fill = 0L,
  round_to_int = TRUE,
  min_time = 1,
  max_time = Inf,
  seed = NULL
) {
  # within function only-if-null helper
  `%||%` <- function(x, y) if (is.null(x)) y else x

  stopifnot(is.matrix(adj_truth))
  if (!all(adj_truth %in% c(0, 1))) {
    stop("adj_truth must be a 0/1 adjacency matrix.")
  }
  if (!is.null(seed)) set.seed(seed)

  tm <- matrix(non_edge_fill,
               nrow = nrow(adj_truth),
               ncol = ncol(adj_truth),
               dimnames = dimnames(adj_truth))

  edges <- which(adj_truth == 1L, arr.ind = TRUE)
  m <- nrow(edges)
  if (m == 0L) {
    warning("No edges in adj_truth; return all `non_edge_fill` matrix.")
    return(tm)
  }

  dist <- match.arg(dist)

  if (dist == "norm") {
    mean <- params$mean %||% 1
    sd   <- params$sd   %||% 0.25
    if (!is.finite(mean) || !is.finite(sd) || sd < 0) {
      stop("For normal distribution, `mean` must be finite and `sd` >= 0.")
    }
    vals <- rnorm(m, mean = mean, sd = sd)
  } else {
    stop("Unsupported `dist`. Extend here for other distributions.")
  }

  vals <- pmin(pmax(vals, min_time), max_time)
  if (round_to_int) {
    vals <- as.integer(round(vals))
    vals[vals < 1L] <- 1L
  }

  tm[edges] <- vals
  tm
}
```

```{r}
as_binary_adj_from_DD <- function(edge_matrix) {
  stopifnot(is.matrix(edge_matrix))
  A <- matrix(0L, nrow = nrow(edge_matrix), ncol = ncol(edge_matrix),
              dimnames = dimnames(edge_matrix))
  A[edge_matrix == 1L] <- 1L
  A
}

# 核心：依据“不可由间接路径解释”的原则，从第2轮挑选新增直达边
infer_new_direct_edges_between_rounds <- function(
  adj_DD1,  # 第一轮的 0/1 邻接（直达边）
  adj_DD2   # 第二轮的 0/1 邻接（含传播后的候选直达边）
) {
  if (!requireNamespace("igraph", quietly = TRUE)) {
    stop("Please install.packages('igraph') for reachability checks.")
  }
  stopifnot(is.matrix(adj_DD1), is.matrix(adj_DD2))
  stopifnot(identical(dimnames(adj_DD1), dimnames(adj_DD2)))

  # 仅在第二轮出现而第一轮没有的候选边
  cand <- (adj_DD2 == 1L) & (adj_DD1 != 1L)
  if (!any(cand)) {
    # 没有候选，直接输出
    confidence <- adj_DD1 + adj_DD2
    return(list(
      adj_combined = (adj_DD1 | adj_DD2) * 1L,
      new_edges_from_round2 = matrix(0L, nrow = nrow(adj_DD1), ncol = ncol(adj_DD1),
                                     dimnames = dimnames(adj_DD1)),
      confidence = confidence
    ))
  }

  # 联合图 U = E1 ∪ E2
  U <- (adj_DD1 | adj_DD2) * 1L
  genes <- rownames(U)

  # 构图（带权与否都可；这里仅用可达性，设为非加权有向图）
  g_from_adj <- function(A) {
    igraph::graph_from_adjacency_matrix(A, mode = "directed", diag = FALSE)
  }

  # 对每条候选边 (u,v)，在 U 去掉该边后，看是否仍有 u->v 路径
  new_from_r2 <- matrix(0L, nrow = nrow(U), ncol = ncol(U), dimnames = dimnames(U))

  # 将候选列表列成边集
  ij <- which(cand, arr.ind = TRUE)
  for (k in seq_len(nrow(ij))) {
    i <- ij[k, 1]; j <- ij[k, 2]

    # 临时移除边 (i,j)
    U_minus <- U
    U_minus[i, j] <- 0L

    g <- g_from_adj(U_minus)

    # 判断 u->v 是否可达（有路径即可）
    # igraph::distances 返回有限值表示可达
    d <- igraph::distances(g, v = i, to = j, mode = "out")
    reachable_without_e <- is.finite(d)
    if (!reachable_without_e) {
      # 无任何间接路径可解释 => 作为新增直达边
      new_from_r2[i, j] <- 1L
    }
  }

  # 合并：第一轮直达 ∪ 第二轮新增直达
  adj_combined <- (adj_DD1 | new_from_r2) * 1L

  # 置信度：两轮出现次数之和（0/1/2）
  confidence <- adj_DD1 + adj_DD2

  list(
    adj_combined = adj_combined,
    new_edges_from_round2 = new_from_r2,
    confidence = confidence
  )
}
```


```{r}

adj_DD2 <- as_binary_adj_from_DD( adj_DD_time2)
```
